component.name: Imladris
component.summary: Scientific notebook studio and Markdown editor

description.p: Imladris is a native Linux polyglot document studio and scientific Markdown editor built with Vala, GTK4, Libadwaita, GtkSourceView 5, and WebKitGTK 6.0. Featuring an adaptive ribbon interface, Imladris provides a distraction-free writing environment for technical authors, data scientists, and researchers.
Whether editing Quarto research reports, R Markdown statistical documents, or Jupyter notebooks, Imladris renders mathematical formulas, tables, and charts in real time.

ul.li: Categorized Launch Modal: 9 creation targets across multi-file projects (Standard and Sandboxed) and standalone simple files
Sandbox Dependency Engine: Isolated environments with renv for R and venv for Python
The .mallorn Exchange Format: 1:1 bidirectional compatibility with RStudio projects and portable single-file bundles
OpenDocument Export Pipeline: Headless export to ODT and ODP presentations
Adaptive Modern Ribbon: High-density GTK4 and Libadwaita tabs for Home, Insert, Computation, Publish, and View with linked controls and quick collapse (Ctrl+F1)
Real-Time Live Preview: WebKitGTK 6.0 preview with KaTeX mathematics, Mermaid diagrams, and syntax highlighting
Dual AI Co-Author: In-editor writing assistant with support for local offline models and cloud LLMs
Model Context Protocol (MCP): Built-in MCP server integration for agentic document analysis and data retrieval

description.p: Note: This application is independently developed and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Posit, RStudio, or Project Jupyter.

description.p: Release v0.13.0 introduces an Obsidian-style JavaScript Extension & Plugin Engine powered by JavaScriptCore (JSC.Context): Enables lightweight, isolated JavaScript plugins with onload/onunload lifecycle hooks; provides declarative imladris bridge exposing native toasts, dynamic ribbon buttons in the Extensions ribbon group, safe GtkSource.Buffer read/insert actions, gated R and Python console execution, and Elrond AI queries; supports one-click bundle imports (.implugin and .zip) with permission and GPLv3 license consent modals; and adds an Extensions management page in Preferences.

Release v0.12.2 delivers the complete Conventional Software Architecture and Engineering Audit refactoring: Eliminates dormant proto-code and uncalled methods in MallornManager and ElrondEngineController; resolves GObject lifecycle memory retention across document tabs via Adw.TabView close_page hooks and explicit signal disconnection; fixes syntax language mapping for .qmd files in GtkSourceView; eliminates whole-document string duplication in frontmatter parsing; resolves nested block formatting in basic_markdown_to_html; optimizes host command generation; and synchronizes MCP server protocol metadata.

Release v0.12.1 resolves container exit 127 issues and streamlines multimedia insertion: Transitions Elrond AI into a robust Smart Local Server & Agent Harness Bridge supporting Ollama (:11434), LM Studio (:1234), Cherry Studio / LocalAI (:23333 / :8080), and host Antigravity CLI (agy); introduces an interactive file picker dialog for images and videos with automatic asset copying to the project's /img subfolder in sandboxed projects; supports format-aware Quarto video shortcodes and HTML5 video rendering in live preview; and adds an About Imladris dialog with documentation links, ecosystem credits, and Gemini Assistance acknowledgment.

Release v0.12.0 introduces major enhancements across AI architecture, GNOME 51 integration, and layout flexibility: Reworks the internal llama.cpp engine with soname symlink preservation, Flatpak host fallback, and 60-second health handshakes; modernizes UI spinners to Adw.Spinner with GNOME 51 platform targeting; adds user preferences for inline AI editing popovers and dynamic Left/Right side panel docking; bundles official vector SVG brand logos across all frontier and local AI models; and publishes the full architectural blueprint and bug localization matrix.

Release v0.11.0 delivers enhanced UX controls and comprehensive performance optimizations: Introduces an intuitive 3-stop slider (Low, Medium, High) for Elrond Assistance Level, automatic host distribution detection displaying tailored llama.cpp installation commands across Debian, Fedora, Arch, openSUSE, Solus, and NixOS, and dual backend switching between Vulkan and NVIDIA CUDA. Also includes major codebase deduplication and performance tuning, caching telemetry size calculations, extracting the standalone PackageIndexCache service, and removing dormant legacy code.

Release v0.10.0 introduces the unified 'Write with Elrond Assistance (AI)' zero-configuration local copilot and telemetry status bar monitor. Features automatic Qwen2.5-Coder-3B model bootstrapping, zero-setup llama-server lifecycle management with Vulkan GPU offloading and CPU fallback, real-time RAM/VRAM telemetry polling every 2 seconds, editor context menu action and Ctrl+Shift+E shortcut. Also introduces the dedicated top 'Packages' Ribbon Tab with live prefix autocomplete, ETag disk caching, O(log N) binary search, pak and uv fast-path installation, and automatic sandboxed lockfile synchronization.

Release v0.9.0 introduces the Automated micromamba Data Science Toolchain Manager and 4-tier runtime resolution hierarchy (Project Sandbox → Managed Global Toolchain → Host Flatpak Spawn → Host Native). Provides one-click automated installation of R 4.4 with dev compilers, IRkernel, pre-compiled tidyverse, Python 3.12 with uv, and Quarto CLI into user storage ($XDG_DATA_HOME/imladris/toolchains/) with zero root permissions and zero host compilation errors. Enables completely self-contained execution on clean Linux installations inside Flatpak containers.

Release v0.8.0 introduces transparent host R interpreter discovery and execution support inside Flatpak sandboxes via the flatpak-spawn host portal, shared host-sandbox cache directory (~/.cache/imladris) for graphics plots and temporary scripts, and real-time package compilation log streaming to the interactive console pane.

Release v0.7.0 brings the complete 11-pillar expansion, modernized Libadwaita Ribbon menu with 5 consolidated high-density tabs and collapsible deck (Ctrl+F1), appearance theming with GNOME default accent colors, and a vastly expanded AI Assistant subsystem: First-class support for Google Gemini (AI Studio and Google OAuth token), Claude (Anthropic Messages API with thinking blocks), OpenAI (GPT-4o, o1, o3-mini), Cursor API compatibility, NVIDIA NIM cloud endpoints, DeepSeek (including DeepSeek-R1 reasoning stream extraction), Kimi (Moonshot AI), Qwen (Alibaba DashScope), Ollama, and LM Studio local server with persistent user credentials; clean launch modal with clean UI labels, context-aware ribbon state machine, RStudio-style package installer for CRAN and PyPI, interactive R and Python persistent consoles with inline chunk output cards and plot rendering, automatic pwd synchronization, sandboxed project engine with RStudio and Jupyter export, 1:1 DCF parity for .mallorn bundles, and headless ODT/ODP pipeline.

Release v0.6.0 introduces the 6 core pillars: Categorized creation pop-up dialog with 9 creation targets, sandboxed vs standard project engines (renv and venv isolation), the 1:1 RStudio-compatible .mallorn exchange format, and comprehensive ODT and ODP OpenDocument export pipelines.
Release v0.5.1 standardizes the canonical Flatpak and Freedesktop Application ID to io.github.Antux912012.Imladris and includes the Phase 1.1.3 RStudio 4-Quadrant Drag-and-Drop Docking System.

Release v0.5.0 introduces dynamic UI morphing (GNOME Apostrophe distraction-free mode and RStudio 4-quadrant workbench), full multi-format adapters (.md, .qmd, .rmd, .ipynb), atomic crash recovery with shadow buffer caching, and 5 interactive Smart Ribbon popovers.
Release v0.4.0 with AI co-authoring assistance, polyglot auto-completion, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration.
Release v0.3.0 featuring WebKitGTK 6.0 live preview, KaTeX math rendering, and multi-format export.
